fact: The Minister of Trade and Industry launched Malawi's National Single Window on 20 May 2025, live first for the trade ministry with seven MDAs at go-live and 22 agencies planned by September 2025, and SATCP's project manager says it integrates with the Malawi Revenue Authority's ASYCUDA World system.
The Malawi Revenue Authority says it is upgrading its customs management system from ASYCUDA World 4.3.3 to 4.4, with migration scheduled for 11 January 2025.
The Malawi Revenue Authority says it supports clearing agents, importers and exporters on its ASYCUDA World 4.3.3 system at all customs stations across the country.
Since February 2025 Kalondola has been linked to Asycuda, described as the customs clearance system, so imports in specified categories must meet stamp requirements at entry points.

UNCTAD's ASYCUDA Programme says ASYCUDAWorld 4.3.3 was rolled out by the Malawi Revenue Authority in Blantyre on 20 October 2023, and MRA's Dedza station manager says it is used to process imports and exports and to declare goods.
